entries.proposition: The review attaches 10/58 vs 2/60 to ENU-treated heterozygous mice.
entries.snippet: When mice are given a single dose of ENU (powerful chemical mutagen), 17.2 % (10/58) of the heterozygous WWOX KO mice develop papillary carcinoma of the lung, compared with 3.3% (2/60) of the wide type
entries.anchor: Section 'WWOX deregulation is associated with carcinogenesis and metastasis' (ref 12)

entries.proposition: The review states metabolic disease as a consequence of reduced WWOX, after a section whose evidence is homozygous knockout rodents.
entries.snippet: reduced or lost expression of WWOX will lead to development of metabolic diseases
entries.anchor: Section 'Bone metabolism disorders', closing sentence (same wording in the Abstract)

entries.proposition: The skeletal sentence speaks of mice but cites a rat paper (ref 16).
entries.snippet: WWOX-/- mice also suffer a disorder of skeleton development and increased osteoclast activity, characterized by thinner cortical bones and decreased mineral density and bone volume
